description: Related buttons joined into one control.

aria-label.description: Names the group for screen readers.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Put any Buttons inside. The corners and borders between them join up in every style.

examples.title: Split button
examples.description: A main action with a second button for more options.

examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: Stacked buttons, for side panels and narrow toolbars.

a11y: role="group" with an aria-label tells screen readers the buttons belong together.
Each button keeps its own label and stays in the Tab order.
Icon-only buttons in a group still need an aria-label.
For on/off choices, use Toggle Group instead, so the pressed state is announced.
